items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I had a boy named Roger Sequire and Roger helped me arrange the music.

ctx.x: No, I didn't get a chance to see the show yet, but do you remember the numbers that you arranged for, what were they.
I got to get it. I arranged the whole show at the theatre from down in Washington. I had a boy named Roger Sequire and Roger helped me arrange the music.
